phase_name: Premium Soil Health Dashboard & Farm Digital Twin Integration
verdict: PHASE F5B-2 VERIFIED — READY FOR F5C
key_features_verified: Farm selector with profile summary and district/upazila context
Latest soil test hero card with laboratory provenance and test date
NPK nutrient cards with explicit units (kg/ha, ppm, %, etc.)
Soil pH card with visual color gauge (acidic, neutral, alkaline)
Organic matter (%), Electrical conductivity (dS/m), Soil moisture (%), Texture class
Interactive historical trend chart sorted chronologically ascending by sample date
Trend metric toggles (pH, NPK, OM & Moisture)
Historical test records table with edit and delete actions
Add / Edit soil test modal with client-side physical validation (pH 0-14, NPK non-negative)
Delete confirmation modal with safe cancel
Strict null-value policy: unmeasured fields display 'তথ্য পাওয়া যায়নি', NEVER coerced to 0 or 0.0
Farm Digital Twin integration: compact soil summary card (data-testid='twin-soil-summary') with button linking to Soil Health Dashboard (data-testid='view-full-soil-dashboard-btn')
Phase F5C Handoff Card ('AI ফসল সুপারিশ') with unit calibration caveats and navigation link to 7 AI Models Console

ai_models_status.unit_calibration_caveat: Public 22-crop benchmark with macro F1 0.993; NOT validated advice for Bangladesh farmland.
